answer: Graph-based trust propagation: trust flows outward from a small seed set along vouching edges and decays at every hop, so an attacker pays for N separate edges into the honest region to run N fake identities. A farm of N clones linked only to each other still fails, because the sybil cluster hangs off the reef like a river with one narrow mouth, and a grove of fakes receives almost no trust, so the attacker pays N times.
